name: Sound BlasterX Katana
author: Boris SdK
description: Keep the volume of a Creative Sound BlasterX Katana in sync with the PC, pick its stored sound profiles, and edit the equalizer and enhancements of its Personal profile.

barWidget.description: Volume bar in sync with the system volume, stored sound profiles, and the equalizer and enhancements of the Personal profile.

schema.label: Sync volume
schema.description: Keep the system volume and the Katana's volume bar together, in both directions (each bar point is 2%).

schema.label: Announce profile changes
schema.description: Show an on-screen message when the profile changes on the speaker.
